title: Trade journal (the owner's own broker trades, published from the research environment)
description: Every closed trade of the owner's own brokerage account, matched first in, first out from the broker's filled orders, and the lots still open. Read only: it is a record of what happened, it suggests nothing and nothing here can trade. No account number, no buying power, no notes; the account value appears only in `money`.

as_of.description: When the broker's history was read: an ISO time with its zone.

source.description: Which broker the trades came from.

fees_included.description: False when the broker's history carries no commissions or fees, so every result is before them.

fills.description: Filled orders the trades were matched from.

history_from.description: The first day the broker's history was read from.

open.description: Lots bought or sold and not yet closed, at what they cost. No current price: the page does not mark them.

gaps.description: Places where the broker's history did not add up: a close with no open before it, so its result is the whole credit.

money.description: Money moved into and out of the account, and what the account is worth, in the account's base currency. The owner's own record, read from their broker; null until it is first read.

currency.description: The account's base currency, which every amount here is in.

usd_rate.description: Units of the base currency per US dollar at as_of, as the broker valued the account.

complete_from.description: The transfer list is complete from this day on; null when earlier transfers may be missing.

source.description: statement: from the owner's broker records. detected: a change in the account's value its trades do not explain.

values.description: The account's value at the end of each recorded day, oldest first.

asset.description: What was traded: a call, a put, or the stock itself.

side.description: Long: bought first. Short: sold first.

qty.description: Contracts or shares in this matched piece.

entry.description: Price per share or per contract share at the open.

exit.description: Price at the close; 0 for an option that expired worthless.

multiplier.description: 100 for an option contract, 1 for a share.

close.description: How it ended: closed by an order, or left to expire.
